about: Hand overrides for the family year map (client/src/lib/familyYear.generated.ts). Each entry pins one devotion, by its id in any client/public/family-devotions*.json file, to the week that begins on the given Sunday (a week the rotation serves, not one a daily seasonal set serves), for example { "week": "2027-01-10", "devotion": "forgiveness", "note": "why this week" }. A pinned week does not use up a slot in the rotation. After editing, run: node scripts/build-family-year.mjs

weeks.note: The week after the November 3 vote, when the results come to dinner (U11). Waits until family-devotions-world.json is live.
